{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Compute the fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
total_patients = len(data_dedup)
severe_patients = data_dedup['severity'].eq('severe').sum()
fraction_severe = severe_patients / total_patients

print(f"Total unique patients after deduplication: {total_patients}")
print(f"Number with severe baseline disease: {severe_patients}")
print(f"Fraction with severe baseline disease: {fraction_severe}")

# Return the fraction as a number
fraction_severe"}
